### Phase 12: contiguous forward DCT passes

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase12-contiguous-forward-dct/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Screen a contiguous-pass implementation of the separable forward 2-D DCT identified by the Phase 11 profile. Preserve coefficient orientation, supported shapes, decoder validity, and deterministic behavior; retain the change only if focused kernel tests and fresh end-to-end PGO timing show a material gain without an unacceptable quality or size regression.
